_comment: P02.08.01. Two speeds on purpose: a security fix should not wait for the weekly batch, and a routine bump should not interrupt a working day. Everything arrives as a pull request that runs the full gate set — Renovate never merges here, because merging to main is a founder action.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Routine updates arrive in batches, so review is one pass rather than twenty.
A major bump is read on its own; that is where the breaking change is.
The toolchain baseline is pinned by ADR-0002. A bump is an ADR amendment, not a routine update.
Actions and container images are pinned by digest (P02.06.06); Renovate keeps the digest current and the comment honest.
A brand-new release has had no time to be found wrong. Three days is cheap insurance against a compromised or broken publish.
